You can configure Outbound Webhooks to receive a copy of delivery notifications for messages sent via Instagram and for a copy of incoming messages received using Instagram by navigating to 'Assets -> Integrations -> Outbound Webhooks' sections in the platform.

## Outbound Webhook configuration for tracking Instagram message delivery status

If you want to track message delivery status, select the Webex Connect Service you are sending the Instagram messages from under 'Entity' dropdown. Select the channel as Instagram.

```json Read
{
    "deliveryInfoNotification": {
        "deliveryInfo": {
            "timeStamp": "2022-07-11T15:40:35.113+05:30",
            "Description": "Read",
            "code": "7502",
            "deliveryChannel": "instagram",
            "additionalInfo": "",
            "destination": "5275638769194520",
            "destinationType": "igsid",
            "deliveryStatus": "Read"
        },
        "subtid": "",
        "transid": "95d9d8fb-fe31-4409-998a-69073f93bc57",
        "callbackData": "customerID123|1234|new_sale",
        "correlationid": "de36bb32-3f5d-46c9-b132-15e010a80ccc"
    }
}
```
```json Submitted
{
    "deliveryInfoNotification": {
        "deliveryInfo": {
            "timeStamp": "2022-06-27T12:49:47.752+05:30",
            "Description": "Submitted",
            "code": "7501",
            "deliveryChannel": "instagram",
            "additionalInfo": "",
            "destination": "5275638769194520",
            "destinationType": "igsid",
            "deliveryStatus": "Submitted"
        },
        "subtid": "",
        "transid": "4da0671d-84bd-43ff-86a7-c08f3a0b5d21",
        "callbackData": "customerID123|1234|new_sale",
        "messageId": "aWdfZAG1faXRlbToxOklHTWVzc2FnZAUlEOjE3ODQxNDU0MDI4MzI3NjMzOjM0MDI4MjM2Njg0MTcxMDMwMDk0OTEyODMwNjQwMjE1NjYyMzExMDozMDU1MzYwNzYxMjU2MjI4ODgyNDgzNDczMjY4NzYyMjE0NAZDZD",
        "correlationid": "de36bb32-3f5d-46c9-b132-15e010a80ccc"
    }
}
```
```json Failed
{
    "deliveryInfoNotification": {
        "deliveryInfo": {
            "timeStamp": "2022-06-08T06:28:57.847Z",
            "Description": "Service provider exception.",
            "code": "7010",
            "deliveryChannel": "instagram",
            "additionalInfo": "(#200) Please check if IG business connected to FB page correctly. Or check if page token has enough IG permissions granular scopes for IG send api.",
            "destination": "5343911549005044",
            "destinationType": "igsid",
            "deliveryStatus": "Failed"
        },
        "subtid": "",
        "transid": "2390a61e-19a8-4689-a697-518bc9380084",
        "callbackData": "customerID123|1234|new_sale",
        "correlationid": "de36bb32-3f5d-46c9-b132-15e010a80ccc"
    }
}
```



## Outbound Webhook configuration for tracking incoming Instagram messages and events

If you want to track incoming messages or events, select the Instagram channel asset you are receiving the messages on under 'Entity' dropdown. 

### Incoming Messages

```json Text
{
    "userId": "",
    "channel": "instagram",
    "igsid": "5343911549005044",
    "appId": "a_637892544015410000",
    "event": "MO",
    "ts": "2022-06-03T14:46:00.620+05:30",
```

## API reference metadata

These are source metadata and examples. `api.auth` is ReadMe metadata; verify authentication in the documented headers/security scheme.

```json
{
  "method": "get",
  "url": "",
  "auth": "required",
  "results": {
    "codes": [
      {
        "name": "",
        "code": "{}",
        "language": "json",
        "status": 200
      },
      {
        "name": "",
        "code": "{}",
        "language": "json",
        "status": 400
      }
    ]
  },
  "params": [],
  "examples": {
    "codes": []
  }
}
```
